title: sidecar
description: Where a card's sources came from and how the card was made: <stem>.json beside the card <stem>.md, in the same folder (ADR-018 §3). Source n here belongs to quote n under the card's `## Sources`. No key outside this schema.

card_id.description: The card_id of the card beside it.

filed_by.description: The person id of who filed the card; empty when the card it was converted from recorded nobody.

sources.description: One entry per quote under `## Sources`, in the same order.

source.title: source
source.description: One thing the card was made from. Its words are the matching quote on the card.

role.description: original: what was sent; reply: a person's answer to it, from any channel; note: what a person gave a reprocess.

person.description: Who sent it: a person id, or a correspondent's name.

time.description: an ISO 8601 time with its offset, 2026-10-21T08:55:00+02:00 or 2026-10-21T06:55:00Z, or unknown on a source marked reconstructed

id.description: The channel's id for it: a Matrix event id, an email's message-id, paperless:<id>; <channel>:<hex> for a channel without ids of its own (cli, agent, cards); unknown when nobody recorded it.

media.description: sha256:<hex>, the hash of the binary in the media store

text.title: text form
text.description: Which text form of a binary or a link the quote shows.

made.description: When the text form was made.

reconstructed.description: true when the source was rebuilt from a card that recorded it badly: a guessed value, an unknown time or id, words with prompt text in them.

then.description: a time nobody recorded is `unknown` only on a source marked "reconstructed": true

made.title: made
made.description: The last interpretation of the sources: the rest of the card. Every field is left out when it is not known.

at.description: an ISO 8601 time with its offset

model.description: The language model that interpreted the sources.

code_commit.description: The famstack commit that ran; unknown when the process was not started by the stack.

prompt_template.description: A hash of the prompt's wording without the values of one call. Another value means the card was made under other rules.

correction_template.description: The same hash for the prompt that worked corrections in, when there were any.

conversation_template.description: The same hash for the card conversation's prompt (ADR-018 §7), when the card was rebuilt with corrections or edits.

requested_by.description: The person id of who asked for this interpretation.
